crossRefs.note: With the stones he built an altar in Yahweh’s name. He made a trench around the altar, large enough to contain two…
Then Yahweh’s fire fell, and consumed the burnt offering, the wood, the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water…

translations.web: The water ran around the altar; and he also filled the trench with water.
translations.bsb: So the water ran down around the altar and even filled the trench.
translations.kjv: And the water ran round about the altar; and he filled the trench also with water.
translations.asv: And the water ran round about the altar; and he filled the trench also with water.
